subsections.title: Task 3.1 - Retrieve Power Connector
subsections.objective: Retrieve the power connector from the wind farm subsea station.

overview.summary: Navigate to the wind farm, secure the connector, and safely extract it.
overview.success_definition: The connector is fully removed and under control of the ROV.

steps.instruction: Pilot the ROV to the wind farm subsea station.
Identify the power connector and its orientation.
Align the manipulator with the connector handle.
Grip the connector securely.
Pull the connector free from its mount.

live_hints: Make sure the connector is fully secured before pulling.

subsections.title: Task 3.2 - Remove Oil Platform Port Cover
subsections.objective: Remove the protective cover from the oil platform port.

overview.summary: Locate the oil platform port and remove its cover cleanly.
overview.success_definition: The cover is fully removed and the port is exposed.

steps.instruction: Pilot the ROV to the oil platform.
Identify the port and its protective cover.
Position the tool to remove the cover.
Remove the cover from the port.
Move the cover away so the port remains accessible.

live_hints: Ensure the cover is fully removed before proceeding.
Do not block the port after removal.
subsections.completion_prompt: Judge confirms port cover removal complete.

subsections.title: Task 3.3 - Transport and Align Connector
subsections.objective: Transport the connector and align it with the oil platform port.

overview.summary: Carry the connector from the wind farm to the oil platform and align it properly.
overview.success_definition: The connector is positioned correctly in front of the port.

steps.instruction: Carry the connector toward the oil platform.
Keep the connector stable during movement.
Slowly approach the exposed port.
Align the connector orientation with the port.

live_hints: Correct alignment is critical before insertion.
final_checks: Connector positioned in front of port
subsections.completion_prompt: Judge confirms alignment ready for insertion.

subsections.title: Task 3.4 - Install Power Connector
subsections.objective: Insert the power connector into the oil platform port.

overview.summary: Insert the connector carefully and ensure it is properly seated.
overview.success_definition: The connector is fully inserted and remains in place.

steps.instruction: Begin inserting the connector into the port.
Make small adjustments to ensure smooth insertion.
Push until the connector is fully seated.
Release the connector only after it is secure.

live_hints: If resistance occurs, re-align before pushing.
final_checks: Connector remains in place after release

steps.instruction: Confirm the connector is fully installed and stable.
Hold position so the judge can clearly see the final state.
Wait for judge confirmation of Task 3 completion.
